title: Helper function
prompt: The robot needs cubes of numbers, and the work belongs in a helper called `cube` that `cubed` uses. cubed(3) is 27.
hints: cube returns n times n times n; cubed calls cube(n) and returns what it gives back. A function is defined with func and a name on its own line, followed by an indented body.

docs.name: return value
docs.what: Ends the function and hands value back to whoever called it.
